shop.metaTitle: Shop Cup Sleeves by Size, Material and Use | Full Range
shop.metaDescription: Shop cup sleeves in one place: kraft, corrugated, white, black, printed and seasonal styles for 8 oz to 20 oz cups. Orders from 100 pieces, free design help.
shop.blurb: Every cup sleeve we make is listed on this page, from plain kraft and corrugated wraps to fully printed, branded and seasonal designs. Use the grid to compare sleeves by cup size, material and how you plan to use them, then request a quote for the one that suits your counter. Every sleeve can carry your logo, orders start at 100 pieces, design help is free, and standard production takes 7-10 business days after you approve your proof.

sections.title: Browse the Range by Cup Size
sections.body: Most counters pour into 8 oz, 12 oz, 16 oz and 20 oz cups, and our sleeves are cut to fit each of those standard sizes. Fit depends on the diameter and taper of the cup as much as its ounce rating, so two 12 oz cups from different suppliers can need slightly different sleeves. If you serve short espresso drinks, start with our [8oz cup sleeves](/product/8oz-cup-sleeves/), which are sized for the smaller cup profile. For mixed menus, one design can be produced across several sizes so every cup carries the same look. If your cups fall outside the standard range, send us the top diameter, bottom diameter and height, and we will size a custom die line to match.
bullets: 8 oz cups for espresso drinks and short servings
12 oz and 16 oz cups for everyday lattes, tea and drip coffee
20 oz cups for large takeaway orders
Custom sizes cut to your own cup measurements

sections.title: Compare Sleeves by Material
sections.body: Material sets the feel of the sleeve, the look of your print and how much heat reaches the hand. Natural kraft gives an earthy, uncoated look and prints logos cleanly. White paperboard shows bright, full-color artwork and sharp small text. Corrugated board adds a fluted air layer for extra insulation on very hot drinks, and recycled paper builds suit brands that want to cut waste. Every option is food-safe, ships flat and stacks neatly behind the counter. Our [guide to sleeve materials](/product-category/sleeve-materials/) puts the four main boards side by side so you can weigh heat comfort, grip and print color before you choose.

sections.title: Shop by How the Sleeves Will Be Used
sections.body: The same cup can need a different sleeve depending on where it is served. A busy counter needs sleeves that slide on in one motion and come out of a stack cleanly. An event station needs sleeves that stay firm on trays and during long walks. An office pantry may prefer a sturdier sleeve that is used more than once. Our [sleeves grouped by use](/product-category/sleeve-usage/) cover each of these settings.
bullets: Daily cafe service: disposable and hot cup sleeves that apply fast
Events and catering: printed sleeves that carry an event name or sponsor logo
Winter menus: Christmas and holiday designs for limited-time drinks
Offices and commuters: reusable sleeves built for repeat use

sections.title: From Browsing to a Printed Order
sections.body: Every printed design is {price}, with free shipping in the US. Order straight from the product page, or ask for a free quote for very large runs or special finishes; our team replies within 24 hours. Design help is included with every order, with up to 3 free revisions, and you approve a digital proof before anything is printed. Standard production takes 7-10 business days after approval, and rush production is available for an additional fee. Once your sleeves ship, you receive a tracking number by email. When you have found the sleeve you want, [request your free quote](/get-quote/) and tell us the quantity, material and cup size.

faqs.q: How do I order from the shop?
faqs.a: Open any sleeve, choose how many runs of 100 you need and place the order: every design is {price} with free US shipping. We email a free digital proof, and you pay by PayPal or bank transfer invoice once you approve it.

faqs.q: How do I choose between two similar sleeves in the grid?
faqs.a: Start with your cup size, then decide on the look you want: natural kraft, bright white, a solid color or full printed artwork. If two sleeves still seem close, call (503) 461-4788 or email info@thecoffeesleeves.com and our team will point you to the one that suits your drinks and service style.

faqs.q: Can every sleeve in the shop be made in a custom size?
faqs.a: Yes. Each sleeve can be sized to your own cup by matching the wrap length, height and curve to the cup diameter and taper. Share the top and bottom diameter and the cup height with your quote request.

faqs.q: Can I order sleeves with no printing at all?
faqs.a: Yes. Blank sleeves give you the same grip and heat comfort without artwork, which keeps setup simple. You only need to confirm the cup size, board and quantity.

faqs.q: Do you sell cups and lids as well as sleeves?
faqs.a: Yes. Our cups with sleeves and lids listing pairs paper hot cups with a matching sleeve and a lid that sits firmly on the rim, so the whole drink setup comes from one order.

faqs.q: Which listing should I check for seasonal designs?
faqs.a: Christmas and holiday sleeves sit in the sleeve styles group, and Christmas cup sleeves sit in the cup sleeves group. Both can be printed with your own festive artwork and brand colors.

faqs.q: Is free delivery available on shop orders?
faqs.a: Yes. Shipping is free on every order delivered within the USA, whatever the quantity. Your quote shows any rush production charge clearly before you approve it.

sleeve-styles.metaTitle: Coffee Sleeve Styles: Printed, Kraft, Blank and Holiday
sleeve-styles.metaDescription: Compare coffee sleeve styles side by side: printed, branded, blank, black, white, pink and holiday designs, with matte, gloss, spot UV or embossed finishes.
sleeve-styles.blurb: Coffee sleeve styles change how a cup looks in the hand, while the fit and heat comfort stay the same. This group brings together twelve looks: fully printed and branded sleeves, plain blank wraps, solid black, white and pink options, playful cute and funny designs, and Christmas and holiday artwork for winter menus. Every style can be cut for 8 oz to 20 oz cups, finished in matte, gloss, spot UV or embossing, and ordered from 100 pieces.

sections.title: Printed and Branded Styles
sections.body: Printed sleeves are the most popular choice for cafes that want their name on every cup that leaves the counter. Full-color printing handles logos, gradients and photos, while spot color printing keeps a brand color consistent from one batch to the next. Branded sleeves put the logo front and center in a clean layout that stays readable on a curved cup wall. If this is your first run, our [printed sleeve style](/product/printed-coffee-sleeves/) is the simplest place to begin, and our designers will set up the artwork for you at no extra cost.
bullets: Full-color, spot color or one-color printing
Logo, web address, QR code or short message on the front panel
Print on one side or both sides of the sleeve
Free design with up to 3 revisions before your proof

sections.title: Plain and Solid Color Styles
sections.body: Not every counter needs full artwork. Blank sleeves give the same grip and heat comfort with no print setup, which suits offices, mobile carts and event stations that want a tidy cup without a design step. White sleeves offer a bright, smooth surface where logos look sharp and text reads dark and clear. Black sleeves give a premium look and hide light scuffs and fingerprints better than lighter sleeves when stacks are handled often. Pink sleeves come in tones from blush to hot pink, made either from dyed kraft or printed color on white board. Our [blank sleeve style](/product/blank-coffee-sleeves/) is the quickest of these to set up because there is no artwork to approve.

sections.title: Seasonal and Playful Styles
sections.body: Seasonal sleeves let you change the look of your cups without changing your cups. Christmas and holiday sleeves carry festive patterns, greetings and limited-edition artwork for winter drinks, pop-ups and corporate gifting. Cute sleeves lean on soft patterns, small mascots and simple icons, while funny sleeves carry one-liners and quirky illustrations that give customers something to share. Because standard production takes 7-10 business days after proof approval, plan seasonal runs early. Our [holiday sleeve style](/product/holiday-coffee-sleeves/) covers menu launches, gift sets and seasonal timing in more detail.
bullets: Christmas and holiday artwork for winter menus
Cute designs with soft patterns and small icons
Funny designs with jokes and witty one-liners
Room for a drink name or short seasonal message

sections.title: Finishes, Embossing and Size Options
sections.body: A finish changes both the look and the feel of a sleeve. Matte keeps glare low under cafe lighting and gives a soft, natural grip. Gloss makes colors look richer and sharper. Spot UV adds a shiny highlight to a logo or one part of the design, and embossing raises part of the surface so the sleeve feels textured in the hand. Some styles also offer embossed grip zones or a soft-touch feel. Every style can be sized for standard 8 oz, 12 oz, 16 oz and 20 oz cups, and our [8 oz sleeve style](/product/8-oz-coffee-sleeves/) is cut for smaller cup profiles used for short espresso drinks.

faqs.q: Which sleeve style suits a new cafe best?
faqs.a: Most new cafes start with a printed or branded sleeve that shows the logo on every takeaway cup. If you want to keep setup simple while your branding settles, blank kraft or white sleeves are a clean first step, and you can add printed sleeves later.

faqs.q: Can the same artwork be printed on kraft and white sleeves?
faqs.a: Yes. The same layout can be set up on both boards. Colors look warmer and more muted on kraft, while white board shows brighter color and sharper small text, so our designers may adjust contrast slightly for each.

faqs.q: What is the difference between black and white sleeves?
faqs.a: White sleeves give a bright surface for sharp, colorful printing. Black sleeves give a darker, premium look and hide light scuffs and fingerprints better when stacks are handled often. Both offer the same grip and heat comfort.

faqs.q: Can embossing be added to a printed sleeve?
faqs.a: Yes. Embossing can raise a logo or pattern on a printed sleeve, and some styles offer embossed grip zones that add texture where fingers rest. Embossing can be combined with matte, gloss or spot UV finishes.

faqs.q: Do blank sleeves need any artwork?
faqs.a: No. Blank sleeves are made with no print, so you only confirm the cup size, the board and the quantity. They still give the same grip and heat comfort as printed styles.

faqs.q: Can I get cute or funny designs if I have no designer?
faqs.a: Yes. Design help is free with every order. Share your brand colors, your tone and any jokes or themes you like, and our designers will create the artwork and send you a digital proof to review.

faqs.q: Are pink sleeves made from pink board or printed color?
faqs.a: Both are possible. Pink sleeves can be made from dyed kraft for a softer look or printed in pink on white board for an exact shade, from light blush to hot pink.

sleeve-materials.metaTitle: Coffee Sleeve Materials: Kraft, Cardboard, Paper, Corrugated
sleeve-materials.metaDescription: Compare coffee sleeve materials: natural kraft, smooth cardboard, light paperboard and fluted corrugated. See how each one handles heat, grip and print color.
sleeve-materials.blurb: The four coffee sleeve materials we offer are kraft, cardboard, paper and corrugated board, and each one balances heat comfort, grip and print quality in its own way. Kraft gives a natural brown look, cardboard and white paperboard show the brightest color, and corrugated board adds a fluted air layer for hotter drinks. All four are food-safe, ship flat, fit standard 8 oz to 20 oz cups and can be printed with your logo.

sections.title: Kraft: A Natural Look With Clean Logo Print
sections.body: Kraft board has a warm brown color and a slightly textured feel that many customers like for grip. It suits cafes with a minimal or earthy style, and it hides minor scuffs well during daily handling. Logos print cleanly on kraft, although colors look more muted than they do on white board, so bold, simple artwork tends to read best. Kraft is available in standard and heavy weights and in recycled kraft blends, and it is one of our recyclable options. If a natural look matters most, our [kraft sleeve material](/product/kraft-coffee-sleeves/) is the place to start. Because kraft is uncoated in its natural form, it is also one of the simplest sleeves to place in paper recycling where local programs accept paperboard.

sections.title: Cardboard and Paper: Smooth Surfaces for Bright Color
sections.body: Cardboard and paper sleeves are made from paperboard with a smooth surface, including white board and recycled paperboard. White board gives the brightest, most accurate color and the sharpest small text, which matters when a sleeve carries a detailed logo, drink names or a QR code. Board weights across our sleeves run from roughly 200 to 400 GSM. Heavier cardboard grades, with reinforced fold lines, keep their shape on larger cups and through busy rushes, while lighter paper grades slide on quickly and suit everyday service. Our [cardboard sleeve material](/product/cardboard-coffee-sleeves/) covers the sturdier end of the range.
bullets: White board: brightest color and sharpest text
Recycled paperboard: made with recycled content
Heavier grades: hold shape on larger, hotter cups
Lighter grades: quick to apply during rush hours

sections.title: Corrugated: The Most Insulation
sections.body: Corrugated sleeves have a fluted layer of ridges that traps a thin pocket of air between the cup and the hand. That air gap slows heat transfer more than a flat sleeve, and the ridged surface gives a firmer grip when cups are wet or carried quickly. Corrugated sleeves also hold up well in stacks and dispensers instead of flattening. They are made from kraft, white or recycled paper blends and can be printed with your logo, with simple layouts reading best on the textured surface. Corrugated sleeves take up a little more space in storage than flat sleeves, so plan a bit more shelf room behind the counter. For very hot drinks or long walks, our [corrugated sleeve material](/product/corrugated-coffee-sleeves/) gives the most comfort.

sections.title: How to Choose the Right Material
sections.body: Start with the drinks you serve and how far customers carry them, then weigh the look you want for your brand. A drive-thru or delivery menu benefits from more insulation, while a dine-in counter can focus on print quality and speed. Every material can be printed, finished and sized in the same way, so the choice comes down to feel, look and heat comfort. If you are still unsure after comparing the options below, our [paper sleeve material](/product/paper-coffee-sleeves/) is a versatile everyday choice that can be made in kraft or white board.
bullets: Very hot drinks or long carries: corrugated board
Bright, full-color branding: white board or cardboard
Natural, earthy look: kraft
Fast, everyday counter service: paper sleeves
Lower waste: recyclable kraft and recycled paperboard, checked against local recycling rules for any coating

faqs.q: Which sleeve material keeps hands coolest?
faqs.a: Corrugated board. Its fluted ridges trap a layer of air between the cup and the hand, which slows heat transfer more than a flat sleeve. Double-wall versions of other materials are another option for hot drinks.

faqs.q: What board weights are available?
faqs.a: Our sleeves use board from roughly 200 to 400 GSM depending on the product. Heavier board feels sturdier and suits larger, hotter cups, while lighter board slides on faster during busy service.

faqs.q: Which material suits a natural, earthy brand?
faqs.a: Kraft. Its brown color and light texture give a natural look that pairs well with simple one-color or bold logos, and it hides minor scuffs during daily handling.

faqs.q: Which material shows the brightest artwork?
faqs.a: White board, used for our cardboard and white paper sleeves. Its smooth, bright surface gives the most accurate color and the sharpest small text.

faqs.q: Is corrugated board harder to print on?
faqs.a: Corrugated sleeves print well, but the ridged surface suits bold, simple layouts more than fine detail. Keeping the front panel uncluttered helps the logo stay sharp and readable.

faqs.q: Do all four materials fit the same cup sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Kraft, cardboard, paper and corrugated sleeves are all made for standard 8 oz, 12 oz, 16 oz and 20 oz cups, and each can be cut to a custom size for specialty cups.

sleeve-usage.metaTitle: Cup Sleeves for Cafes, Events and Promotions | Shop by Use
sleeve-usage.metaDescription: Cup sleeves for cafes, events and promotions: disposable counter sleeves, hot beverage wraps, reusable office sleeves and printed promo runs from 100 pieces.
sleeve-usage.blurb: Choose cup sleeves for cafes, events and promotions by how each cup will be used. Busy counters need disposable sleeves that apply in one motion, event and catering stations need sleeves that stay firm on trays and long walks, and promotions need a clear print area for a logo, offer or QR code. This group covers hot coffee, hot beverage, general beverage, disposable and reusable sleeves, all printable from 100 pieces with free design help.

sections.title: Everyday Cafe Service
sections.body: At a busy counter, the right sleeve is one your team never has to think about. Disposable sleeves ship flat, stack neatly in dispensers and slide onto a cup in one motion, so staff can sleeve and serve without slowing the line. They add a comfortable grip layer and reduce heat on the hand, which removes the need to double-cup fresh drinks. Sleeves made for fresh hot coffee are sized for the cups you use most and keep a steady fit while customers walk, drive or wait. Our [disposable sleeves for daily service](/product/disposable-coffee-sleeves/) are the standard choice for high-volume counters.
bullets: Ship flat and stack in dispensers
Apply in one motion during rush hours
Remove the need for double-cupping
Printable with your logo or left plain

sections.title: Events, Catering and Pop-Ups
sections.body: Event service compresses pickup into short windows, and drinks often travel on trays or across a venue before anyone takes a sip. Sleeves that keep their shape and stay in place make those handoffs smoother. Beverage sleeves cover coffee, tea and cocoa across cup sizes from 8 oz to 24 oz, and can be printed with an event name, a sponsor logo or a schedule note. For catering trays, a sleeve with a firm grip helps staff hand off several drinks at once without squeezing the cups. Because standard production takes 7-10 business days after proof approval, order event sleeves with time to spare, or ask about rush production for an additional fee. Our [beverage sleeves for events](/product/beverage-sleeves/) suit mixed drink menus.

sections.title: Promotions and Giveaways
sections.body: Every sleeve that leaves your counter carries your message into offices, cars and streets. That makes a printed sleeve a low-cost way to promote a new drink, a seasonal offer, a loyalty program or an online ordering link. A QR code, a short tagline or a web address fits on the front panel without crowding the logo. Hot beverage sleeves stay clear of the rim so lids fit smoothly, and they come in matte, gloss or spot UV finishes so the message stands out under store lighting. Our [hot beverage sleeves for promotions](/product/hot-beverage-sleeves/) give you a clean, readable print area.
bullets: Launch a new or limited-time drink
Add a QR code for ordering or reviews
Show a sponsor or partner logo
Run a seasonal offer across every cup

sections.title: Offices and Repeat Use
sections.body: Office pantries and commuters often want a sleeve that lasts longer than a single drink. Reusable sleeves use thicker or layered board, with an optional water-resistant coating, so they hold their shape and grip through repeated handling. They can carry a logo or a minimal pattern so people recognize their own sleeve and keep using it. Our [reusable sleeves for offices](/product/reusable-coffee-sleeves/) suit workplaces that want to cut down on single-use sleeves. They are made in multiple sizes to fit common cup diameters, and with care they stay in use far longer than a single-use sleeve. For best results, keep them dry and store them flat between uses.

faqs.q: Which sleeves suit a busy cafe counter best?
faqs.a: Disposable or hot coffee sleeves sized to your most common cups. They ship flat, stack in dispensers and slide on in one motion, so staff can sleeve and serve without slowing the line.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I order sleeves for an event?
faqs.a: Allow time for design and proof approval, then 7-10 business days for standard production and typically 3-7 business days for shipping within the USA. If your date is close, rush production is available for an additional fee.

faqs.q: Can a sleeve carry a promotion or QR code?
faqs.a: Yes. A QR code, web address, offer or short tagline can be printed on the front panel next to your logo. High contrast and a clear margin around the code help it scan reliably.

faqs.q: Do event sleeves work for tea and hot chocolate too?
faqs.a: Yes. Beverage and hot beverage sleeves are made for any hot drink served in a paper cup, including tea, hot chocolate and specialty coffee.

faqs.q: How do disposable and reusable sleeves differ?
faqs.a: Disposable sleeves are made for a single drink and are quick to apply at busy counters. Reusable sleeves use thicker or layered board, with an optional water-resistant coating, so they hold shape and grip over repeated use.

faqs.q: Can I order a small run for a single event?
faqs.a: Yes. Printed sleeve orders start at 100 pieces, which suits a single event, a pop-up or a short menu trial.

faqs.q: Can sleeves stop the need to double-cup hot drinks?
faqs.a: Yes. A sleeve adds an insulating grip layer around the cup, which gives the same hand comfort as a second cup while using less material and taking less time at the counter.

sections.title: Custom and Branded Cup Sleeves
sections.body: Custom cup sleeves can be made in different tapers, heights and thicknesses to match the cups you already use. Options include wrap-around, die-cut and locked sleeve shapes, plus details such as finger notches, locking tabs and cut windows. Branded cup sleeves keep your logo visible during takeaway, delivery and event service, and they improve grip when cups get damp from condensation on cold drinks. Choose kraft, white or recycled paperboard, and finish with matte, gloss or spot UV. Our [custom cup sleeves](/product/custom-cup-sleeves/) are the most flexible option when your cups are an unusual shape. Our designers set up the artwork for free and send a digital proof before printing.

sections.title: Sleeves Matched to Your Cups
sections.body: A sleeve only works if it fits. We match each sleeve to the top diameter, taper and height of your cups so it sits snug without pinching, twisting or sliding down. Our 8oz cup sleeves suit short espresso drinks, while hot cup sleeves and sleeves for hot drinks cover everyday 12 oz to 20 oz service. Sleeves for hot drinks work just as well for tea and hot chocolate as for coffee. One design can be adapted across several sizes so your whole menu carries the same look. If you want bright, crisp branding, our [white cup sleeves](/product/white-cup-sleeves/) show logos and colors clearly under cafe lighting.

12 oz to 20 oz sleeves for everyday service
One design adapted across every size
Custom die lines for specialty cups

sections.title: Cups, Lids and Sleeves Together
sections.body: If you would rather source the whole drink setup at once, we also supply paper hot cups with matching sleeves and lids. The cups come in single-wall and double-wall paperboard, the sleeve uses a die-cut fit with a locking notch, and the lid sits firmly on the rim to reduce leaks during carry. Ordering all three together keeps sizes consistent and saves matching parts from different suppliers. It also makes reorders simpler, because a single quote covers the cup, the lid and the sleeve. For winter menus, Christmas cup sleeves add festive artwork to the same setup. See our [cups with sleeves and lids](/product/coffee-cups-with-sleeves-and-lids/) for the complete package.

faqs.q: Can I buy cups and lids with matching sleeves?

faqs.q: Can sleeves be made for cups with an unusual taper?

faqs.q: How many sleeves should a busy cafe keep in stock?
faqs.a: Base your order on average weekly hot drink sales, then add extra cartons for busy seasons. Sleeves ship flat and stack neatly, so a larger order stores easily behind the counter.

faqs.q: How long does a wholesale order take to arrive?
faqs.a: Standard production takes 7-10 business days after you approve your proof, and shipping within the USA typically takes another 3-7 business days. Rush production is available for an additional fee.

If you are not happy with a batch because of an error on our side, tell us what went wrong and we will make it right with a reprint at no additional cost.

faqs.q: What are your phone support hours?
faqs.a: You can reach our team at (503) 461-4788 Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm EST. Outside those hours, email info@thecoffeesleeves.com or use the quote form and we will reply within 24 hours.

faqs.q: How quickly are emails answered?
faqs.a: We reply to emails and quote requests within 24 hours. Including your quantity, material and cup size in the first message helps us send a complete answer right away.

faqs.q: Who should I contact about an order already in production?
faqs.a: Call or email the same team that handled your quote and mention your order details. We can confirm the production stage and expected ship date.

faqs.q: Can I get help choosing a sleeve before I request a quote?
faqs.a: Yes. Call or email with the drinks you serve and the look you want, and our team will suggest a material, size and finish before you commit to anything.

faqs.q: What is your mailing address?
faqs.a: Our address is The Coffee Sleeves, 303 W 137th Street, #5A, New York, NY 10030, United States.

faqs.q: Does requesting a quote commit me to an order?
faqs.a: No. Quotes are free and carry no obligation. You only commit once you approve the quote and your design proof.

faqs.q: Can one quote cover several sizes or designs?
faqs.a: Yes. List each cup size, design and quantity in the project details box, and we will price them together in a single quote.

faqs.q: Do I need finished artwork before asking for a quote?
faqs.a: No. A quote only needs your quantity, material and cup size. If you do not have artwork yet, our designers can create it for free once you go ahead.

faqs.q: Can I upload files with my request?
faqs.a: Yes. The quote form lets you upload artwork, logos or cup photos, and you can also email files to info@thecoffeesleeves.com after submitting.

faqs.q: What if my deadline is very tight?
faqs.a: Mention the date in your request. Rush production is available for an additional fee and can shorten production to 3-5 business days, and our team will confirm whether your date can be met before you approve the quote.

sections.title: What You Will Find Here
sections.body: Our guides answer the questions cafe owners and brand teams ask most often before ordering sleeves. Each one focuses on a single topic and explains it in plain language, with practical steps you can use at your own counter. Start with our guide to [sleeve sizes for 8 oz, 12 oz and 16 oz cups](/blog/coffee-sleeve-sizes-for-8-oz-12-oz-and-16-oz-cups/) if you are matching sleeves to your cups for the first time. Every guide is written for real counters, so the advice works whether you run one cafe or several.
bullets: Cup fit and sizing for common hot cups
Digital and offset printing methods
Eco-friendly material choices
How sleeves protect hands from heat
Planning seasonal and holiday campaigns

sections.title: Using the Guides to Plan an Order
sections.body: The guides follow the same order as most purchasing decisions. First, confirm the size of your cups and how hot your drinks are, since that decides how much insulation you need. Next, choose a material that suits your brand and your waste goals. Then decide how the sleeve will be printed, from simple one-color logos to full-color artwork, and which finish will make the design stand out under your lighting. For winter menus, our guide to [holiday sleeves for seasonal campaigns](/blog/holiday-coffee-cup-sleeves-for-seasonal-campaigns/) explains how to plan artwork and timing so seasonal sleeves arrive before your menu launches.

sections.title: When You Are Ready to Order
sections.body: Reading is a good start, but our team can apply the advice to your own cups and drinks. Send your quantity, material and cup size through the [quote form](/get-quote/) and we will reply within 24 hours with pricing and turnaround. Design help is free, and you approve a proof before anything is printed.

faqs.q: Which guide should I read before my first order?
faqs.a: Start with the sizing guide, because fit decides whether a sleeve stays in place. Then read the materials and printing guides to choose a board and print method that suit your brand.

faqs.q: Do the guides apply to tea and hot chocolate as well as coffee?
faqs.a: Yes. The advice on fit, heat protection, materials and printing applies to any hot drink served in a paper cup.

faqs.q: Where can I ask a question a guide does not answer?
faqs.a: Call (503) 461-4788 or email info@thecoffeesleeves.com. Our team replies within 24 hours and can help with questions about your own cups and artwork.

faqs.q: Do the guides cover planning for the holiday season?
faqs.a: Yes. Our seasonal campaign guide covers holiday artwork ideas and how to time your order so sleeves arrive before your winter menu starts.
